mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,purpose,identifier_type,target_key_hmac,delivery_mode,code_mac,mac_key_version,state,generation,attempts,max_attempts,auth_version,created_at,expires_at,next_send_at,verified_at,consumed_at FROM verification_challenge WHERE target_key_hmac=#{target} AND purpose=#{purpose} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,user_id,purpose,identifier_type,target_key_hmac,delivery_mode,code_mac,mac_key_version,state,generation,attempts,max_attempts,auth_version,created_at,expires_at,next_send_at,verified_at,consumed_at FROM verification_challenge WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_challenge SET state='SUPERSEDED' WHERE user_id=#{id,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND state IN ('SENDING','SENT','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE verification_challenge SET state=#{state} WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND state='SENDING'
UPDATE verification_challenge SET state=CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END WHERE state='SENDING' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now},INTERVAL 30 SECOND)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM verification_challenge WHERE expires_at < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM password_reset_credential r WHERE r.challenge_id=verification_challenge.id) LIMIT 200
